text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With Bitter Glace on a slump, Trainer 
Kashimoto consulted Byerley Turk to find a 
breakthrough.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To improve one's win rate, one shouldn't 
rely solely on raw physicality, but also 
cultivate the flexibility and adaptability 
needed to accurately read how a race 
unfolds.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, that simultaneously meant 
changing the way Bitter Glace ran.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she were to try to win with her current 
running style, even harsher training would 
be necessary. However, that would also 
increase the risk of injury.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Trainer Kashimoto made up her mind and 
recommended a different running style to 
Bitter Glace—one that placed emphasis on 
tactics over brute physicality.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though Bitter Glasse was bewildered, 
driven by her desire to win and Trainer 
Kashimoto's wish to lead her to victory, 
she resolved to change her running style.
